theme_overview.name: Luxury Wedding Return Gifts E-Commerce
theme_overview.description: A modern, premium, fully responsive e-commerce website for a brand that sells Wedding Return Gifts. The theme is elegant, luxurious, and minimal. Emphasizes visual storytelling with generous negative space, high-contrast typography, and smooth micro-interactions. The aesthetic is heavily inspired by high-end editorial and 'Godly' level ecommerce platforms.
theme_overview.color_palette_context: Ivory, White, Gold, Beige, Soft Pink, and Champagne. Use these colors to establish a high-end, exclusive feel without overwhelming the products.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant. A luxury serif for headings mixed with a sterile, crisp geometric sans for body.

headings.rules: Use tracking-tight for H1 and H2. Never use generic sans-serif for headings.

body.rules: Clean, highly readable, generous line height (leading-relaxed).

labels.rules: Uppercase, tracking-widest (e.g., tracking-[0.2em]), text-xs or text-sm for overlines and tags.

rules: Limit the use of primary Gold (#D4AF37) to CTAs, badges, and active states.
Ensure contrast ratios are met (minimum 4.5:1 for small text).
Never use pure black or pure white without a subtle tint. Light backgrounds should feel like Ivory or warm paper.
Dark mode backgrounds should be a rich charcoal, not absolute #000.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) for the sticky header and overlays. ALWAYS include a 1px subtle border to define the edge.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px delicate borders (border-stone-200 or border-gold/20). Avoid thick, heavy borders.

shadows.soft: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] for product cards on hover

visual_enhancers.radius: Use rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). High-end luxury avoids overly rounded, bubbly corners.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24. Containers must breathe.
layouts_and_grids.product_grid: Wide gaps (gap-8 md:gap-12). Images must have a consistent aspect ratio (aspect-[4/5] recommended) with object-cover.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: For categories, use an asymmetrical Tetris grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Some items span 8 cols, some span 4 cols to create visual tension and hierarchy.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Optical alignment over mathematical. Do not center-align body text paragraphs.

components.Header: Sticky to top, z-50. Glassmorphism effect. Logo centered or left. Icons (Search, User, Wishlist, Cart) on the right. MUST be fully visible on desktop.
components.Hero: Oversized, editorial feel. Offset headlines. High-quality image background with a delicate gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-black/20 to-transparent) to ensure text contrast.
components.ProductCard: Minimalist. Image takes 80% of height. On hover, image scales slowly (1.05x, 700ms). 'Add to Cart' button slides up from bottom. Discount badges in soft pink or gold.
components.Buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-sm). Primary button: solid Gold background. Secondary: transparent with 1px border. Always define explicit hover text and bg colors.
components.ProductDetail: Split layout. Sticky image gallery on the left (scrollable). Product info, accordion descriptions, and CTA on the right.
components.Cart: Sleek sliding Sheet (Drawer) for quick cart. Full page for detailed summary.
components.Forms: Underlined inputs instead of full bordered boxes, or extremely subtle borders, matching luxury aesthetics.

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slight Y-axis upward drift (y: 20 -> 0) on page load.
motion.scroll_animations: Staggered fade-ins for product grid items (delay 0.1s per index).
motion.micro_interactions: Smooth 500ms-700ms easing for hover states on images. Buttons have a slight shrink/grow effect on active state.

media_and_images.rules: High-resolution. Unsplash/Pexels images mapped to product types. Editorial styling.

hero_banner.description: Luxurious wedding boxes outdoor - Main Hero background

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: 'npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge react-router-dom'.
Configure Tailwind for Dark Mode (class strategy).
Import Google Fonts 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' in index.css.
Implement a responsive layout. Mobile should stack cleanly, desktop should utilize CSS grid (Bento box style) for category sections.
Use Shadcn-like customized components for forms, inputs, and dialogs. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the artistic Marketing/Hero sections.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive elements (e.g., 'data-testid="add-to-cart-btn"').
Build the 15+ requested pages utilizing React Router. Reuse layouts for Shop and Category pages.
Use mock data populated with the provided Unsplash/Pexels image URLs. Do NOT use generic placeholder domains.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky header. Use glassmorphism.
Toasts: Install and use 'sonner' for notifications (e.g., item added to cart).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by implementing generous spacing, sophisticated typography pairings, and unexpected asymmetrical layouts.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always target specific properties like 'transition-transform' or 'transition-colors'.
DO NOT center-align the app container globally. Left-align dense text blocks.
Use subtle grain textures or gradients to build depth. Flat design must be compensated with excellent typography and spacing.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and staggered entrances.
If a component needs a fixed height removed, override it using Tailwind's 'h-auto'.
